content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows anyone to publish web content directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means they can set up a storefront for their ebooks, courses, and other digital products without incurring the costs associated with traditional e-commerce platforms. This is crucial in markets where creators are locked out of major payment processors, as it provides a path to monetize their work directly and sustainably.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages store involves a combination of static web hosting, automated payment processing, and seamless product delivery. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed through a service like NOWPayments, which supports multiple cryptocurrencies. This setup ensures that creators can receive funds directly into their wallets, without the cumbersome fees of traditional payment processors. The entire transaction and delivery process can be automated using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, allowing for instant product access upon payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This approach is specifically designed for digital creators in regions such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where conventional payment platforms are either inaccessible or prohibitively expensive. By using GitHub Pages, these creators can establish a robust online presence and capitalize on their digital products. This model not only promotes financial independence but also enhances the local economy by empowering individuals to sell their work globally without the restrictions imposed by traditional financial institutions.
GitHub Pages offers zero-cost hosting for your digital product store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To set up a GitHub Pages store, you'll need several components: a GitHub account for hosting, NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions, and a delivery mechanism for your digital products, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Each of these components plays a crucial role in ensuring the store operates smoothly. By integrating these tools, creators can create a seamless purchase experience for customers while keeping costs low, especially compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own digital store using GitHub Pages, start by creating a repository on GitHub. Next, configure your store's layout using HTML and CSS, then upload your products. Set up NOWPayments to handle transactions, ensuring you have your crypto wallet ready. Finally, implement an automated delivery system using Google Apps Script or another tool to deliver products immediately after purchase. For a comprehensive guide and resources, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build a fully functional sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage a free hosting service like GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to avoid high fees and maintain ownership over your products. You can process payments directly and deliver digital products automatically, ensuring a smooth customer experience.
NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to just 0.5%, keeping more revenue in your hands.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

This method connects seamlessly with searches around selling digital downloads exclusively through cryptocurrency. For a complete framework to get started, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the blueprints and templates necessary for your digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own store on GitHub Pages. By using NOWPayments for payment processing, you can avoid the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the transaction costs with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than many traditional payment processors. This means more of your sales revenue stays in your pocket.
How quickly can I set up my digital store?
You can set up a digital store on GitHub Pages within a few hours. With the right resources, including templates and payment integration guides, you can be operational very quickly.
